_note: What the release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml -> build/ci-build.sh) builds from: exact commits, exact versions, pinned checksums, so a release tag says exactly what is inside (rel-security H3). paseo/bots/optchat are the fresh-history branches src/paseo, src/paseo-bots and src/pi-optchat of omcdowell/dino-bot (one commit each, made by build/prepare-sources.sh from the public/release trees; build/publish-public.sh SOURCES_GIT=<dir> pushes them). Because they live in the release repo itself, the workflow reads them with its own token: DINOBOT_SOURCES_TOKEN is not needed. Bump: re-run build/prepare-sources.sh, commit this file, push the branches, tag.
